# Kepty Co., Ltd.

> End-to-end Japan market-entry partner for companies based outside Japan.

Kepty Co., Ltd. (株式会社Kepty) runs Japan market entry as one operation: sales, marketing, customer support, and analysis. The work is not tied to one product category. Reporting to headquarters outside Japan is in English.

## Facts

- English name: Kepty Co., Ltd.
- Japanese name: 株式会社Kepty
- Brand: KEPTY
- Founder & CEO: Tomohiro Kajiyama (梶山 知裕)
- Contact: contact@kepty.co
- Market served: Japan
- Clients: companies based outside Japan
- Reporting language to overseas headquarters: English

## What we do

- Japan market entry, handed to one partner in Japan
- Sales: outbound calls, meetings, and order-taking
- Marketing: web marketing (sites and landing pages), social channels, exhibitions and trade shows in Japan
- Customer support before purchase and after purchase
- Data analysis and a review of what to do next
- Daily stand-ups and quantitative and qualitative reporting in English for companies outside Japan
